import re
import sys

values = {}
pattern = re.compile(r"\b(a|b|c|d|TMP)\s*<-\s*(a|b|c|d|TMP|-?\d+)\s*;")

for match in pattern.finditer(sys.stdin.read()):
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = values[source] if source in values else int(source)

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "TMP")) + ";")
